Initial release of sprite-tools: a toolkit for game asset slicing and background removal.

- Added batch grid splitting for images (2x3, 3x2, etc.) with PIL, supporting PNG/JPG/WebP.
- Provided alpha-based background trimming, edge color trimming (with color tolerance), and lightweight background removal without external dependencies.
- All scripts support batch processing and configurable output directories.
- Documentation includes example workflows for integrating with Codex CLI image generation.
- Dependencies: Pillow, numpy (rembg and ImageMagick optional).
